answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller to lock a fixed bond for 30 days before bidding, whether it sells ferrous scrap, prism optics, or comet telemetry. Bonds cannot back multiple identities at once, and a contract slashes them for provably signing conflicting receipts for the same order. Creating names is free, but fielding 1,000 eligible sellers ties up 1,000 bonds, imposing a capital cost even before any fraud penalty.
